_comment: Specs known to fail because they need external configuration, a feature that ships off, or an UNRESOLVED environment problem on the dev machine. NOT a list of acceptable bugs. Every entry must carry a reason in _reasons below, and the list should only ever shrink. Regenerate with bin/check-journey-run.sh --update and say why in the commit message.
known_failing: explore/trending.spec.ts::trending page renders posts + hashtag chips
feed/announcement-dismiss.spec.ts::J-550 a dismissed announcement stays gone for the member after reload
feed/announcement.spec.ts::J-513 admin announcement renders as an announcement; a non-admin has no control
feed/audience-picker.spec.ts::J-510 a followers-only post persists privacy=followers and is hidden from a non-follower
feed/reactors.spec.ts::J-504 reacting puts me in the reactors list
profile/profile-tabs.spec.ts::J-720 profile strength rises when a field is filled

_reasons.explore/trending.spec.ts::trending page: Pre-existing. Needs seeded trending data the fixture does not create.
_reasons.moderation/queue.spec.ts::admin queue pa: Pre-existing. Needs a moderation queue with content.
_reasons.feed/announcement-dismiss.spec.ts::J-550: UNRESOLVED, 2026-08-18. apiRequestContext.post timeout (10s). Grouped with the three below: all fail on the fixture's first authenticated navigation. NOT caused by the 1.1.5 work - none of these areas are touched by it. Card 10211458045.
_reasons.feed/announcement.spec.ts::J-513 admin a: UNRESOLVED, 2026-08-18. page.goto('/?autologin=1') timeout (15s), while the same URL answers in ~0.1s to curl on a fresh session and the page is 60 resources / 18KB / DOMContentLoaded 124ms in a browser. One cause WAS found and fixed (WP-Cron spawning ~47 EDD update checks at a 15s timeout each, 41s cold - now DISABLE_WP_CRON); it did not clear these. Remaining cause unknown. Card 10211458045.
_reasons.feed/audience-picker.spec.ts::J-510 a fo: UNRESOLVED, 2026-08-18. Same first-navigation timeout as J-513. Card 10211458045.
_reasons.feed/reactors.spec.ts::J-504 reacting pu: UNRESOLVED, 2026-08-18. NOT a timeout - an assertion: .bn-reactors-popover__name filtered to the reactor never becomes visible. Distinct from the four navigation timeouts and should be investigated on its own. Card 10211458045.
_reasons.profile/profile-tabs.spec.ts::J-720 prof: UNRESOLVED, 2026-08-18. page.waitForResponse timeout (15s). Same first-navigation family as J-513. Card 10211458045.
